name: @fuaran-ui/charts
description: Render-time Chart → Drawing lowering for Fuaran UI — the bounded, deterministic layout engine that turns a semantic ChartSpec + data rows into a canonical themed Drawing subtree (scales, ticks, axes, gridlines, legend, series geometry). The TypeScript twin of Fuaran.UI.Charts; certified byte-identical to the shared chart-lowering fixtures so a chart renders as first-party inline SVG on every host.
author: Andrew J. Willshire <andrew@fuaran.com> (Diametrical Ltd)
